name: Olifants River
full: Olifants River — Lutzville Valley, Citrusdal Valley remainder & stand-alone wards
terroir: The Olifants River region's remaining ground is a working, largely co-operative wine country on South Africa's arid West Coast, running from Klawer and Vredendal on the Olifants River itself out to Doringbaai on the Atlantic.
lede: The Olifants River region's remaining ground is a working, largely co-operative wine country on South Africa's arid West Coast, running from Klawer and Vredendal on the Olifants River itself out to Doringbaai on the Atlantic.

farms.name: Klawer Wine Cellars
farms.hours: Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00, Sat/public holidays 09:00-13:00, closed Sundays and religious holidays.

farms.name: Lutzville Vineyards
farms.locality: On the Olifants River at Lutzville, on the West Coast Wine Route

farms.name: Fryer's Cove Vineyards
farms.locality: Doringbaai, on the Cape West Coast (the only vineyard the producer's own site describes as being in the Bamboes Bay ward)
farms.history: Wines marketed under two labels: Fryer's Cove and 'Wines of Origin Bamboes Bay'.

farms.name: Seal Breeze Wines
farms.locality: Off the R362, near Lutzville, on the Olifants River
farms.people: Founded and run by Joan Wiggins, who began winemaking as a career change at age 51 without formal training.

farms.name: Cape Rock Wines
farms.locality: Between Vredendal and Lutzville, on the banks of the Olifants River
farms.history: First bottled wine a Shiraz Viognier blend shortly after founding in 2000.

farms.name: Swartberg Wingerde
farms.history: Rudiger Gretschel’s terroir-driven Piekenierskloof project on the Swartberg farm, supplemented by fruit from neighbouring properties.
